# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I want to return a water bottle I bought, and also exchange my pet bed and office chair for the cheapest versions you have. I’d like to do both together. If I can only do one, I want to do whatever saves me the most money. Can you tell me how much I’d save in each option? My name is Mei Davis, zip code 80217.

- Give the email on your account (fastest), or
- Confirm your full name and zip again so I can retry (you already provided Mei Davis, 80217 — I can retry if you prefer).

A few important details I’ll need after we authenticate (or you can tell me now):
- Which order(s) contain the water bottle, pet bed, and office chair (order ids), if you know them. If not, I’ll list your recent orders.
- Confirm the water bottle is a delivered item you want to return.
- Confirm the pet bed and office chair are delivered items you want exchanged to the cheapest available variant of the same product type (no product-type changes). If there are size/color options you prefer, tell me; otherwise I’ll pick the lowest-price available variant.
- Which payment method should refunds or price-difference charges go to? (refunds must go to the original payment method or an existing gift card; exchanges/price differences require a payment method — I’ll show options once I load your account.)

Once you provide your email (or ask me to retry by name+zip), I’ll look up your account and orders and calculate:
- Savings (refunds/price differences) if you only return the water bottle,
- Savings if you only exchange the pet bed + office chair to the cheapest variants,
- Savings if you do both together.

After that I’ll list the exact actions and ask for explicit confirmation (yes) before making any updates. What email should I use to find your account?

Sorry, I don’t remember my email right now. Can you please try again with my name and zip? Mei Davis, 80217.

I don’t know my order IDs either, but all three items were delivered. I just want the cheapest options for the pet bed and office chair, any color or size is fine. Refunds can go to the original payment method.

Please let me know how much I’d save with each option.
